summary: Banco Santander-Chile filed a Form 6-K reporting a local placement of dematerialized bearer bonds. The Bank placed Series BG Bonds (ticker BSTDBG0125) for Ch$14,000,000,000, maturing July 1, 2032, at an average rate of 5.83%. The placement was made under a line of credit registered with the Chilean CMF. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. There are no deal terms of the kind associated with special situations.
